<h1 id="orikalka-basic-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Orikalka - Basic Guide</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/mNg7ZjfeBP.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-information"><ins><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Orikalka has 190,000 LP, across a single fight phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Orikalka primarily attacks with Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, with some Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Other guides: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rex-matriarchs</nowiki></span><nowiki> </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="gear-relics-and-familiars"><ins><nowiki>Gear, Relics and Familiars</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=a9149f4d-fbbb-4cb8-87c7-da567c880499 <nowiki>Example Preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fa9149f4d-fbbb-4cb8-87c7-da567c880499.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stay aware of nearby Matriarchs when moving, as only 3/4 Matriarchs share the main arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You should attack with Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fire spells </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543465116092334083.png?v=1" alt="firesurge" title="firesurge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> give a +27% hit chance boost</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any other style will only deal insignificant damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="attack-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Frost Storm</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pyroclastic Shock</nowiki></strong><nowiki> →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>3x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pyroclastic Shock</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 2x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pyroclastic Shock</nowiki></strong><nowiki> →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>2x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pyroclastic Shock</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → 3x </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pyroclastic Shock</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> →</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="auto-attacks-melee-example-magic-example"><ins><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (</nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/n77pITX1Ix.mp4 <nowiki>Melee example</nowiki>]<nowiki> / </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/ua9uchPcaZ.mp4 <nowiki>Magic example</nowiki>]<nowiki>)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Orikalka uses Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If lower Defence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> pray against Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551452788269127.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommelee" title="protectfrommelee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once you are comfortable surviving the mechanics</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="frost-storm-frostbite-example"><ins><nowiki>Frost Storm / Frostbite</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/icvqcL0erz.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Orikalka spins in place, dealing up to 4500 Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage and applying </nowiki><em><nowiki>Frostbite</nowiki></em><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>While </nowiki><em><nowiki>Frostbite</nowiki></em><nowiki> is active, your global cooldown is doubled for 30 seconds. This makes your abilities feel much slower and lowers your damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If Frost Storm deals too much damage, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1052551456835768351.png?v=1" alt="protectfrommagic" title="protectfrommagic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you get </nowiki><em><nowiki>Frostbite</nowiki></em><nowiki>, either:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep fighting with abilities which don't care about the global cooldown (e.g., channels </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063111104757760.png?v=1" alt="gconc" title="gconc" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or damage-over-time abilities </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clear it using the fissures from </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pyroclastic Shock</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (see below)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="pyroclastic-shock-fissures-example"><ins><nowiki>Pyroclastic Shock / Fissures</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/fxCDXAXY4V.mp4 <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Orikalka slams its tail, creating 3 fissures on the ground. Standing on a fissure deals rapid Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage, with the final hit dealing up to 6000 damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Avoid the fissures unless you are attempting to clear </nowiki><em><nowiki>Frostbite</nowiki></em><nowiki> (see above solution under </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Frost Storm</nowiki></strong><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
